sections.heading: Flagged items in detail
paragraphs: Debt-to-Equity Trajectory: Leverage moved from 1.52x to 1.15x equity. Leverage is high enough to transmit an earnings shock directly into equity value.
Working Capital Cycle (DSO / DIO): The cash conversion cycle absorbs 68 days of working capital. A long cycle ties up cash and makes growth expensive to fund.
Interest Coverage Safety: Operating profit covers interest 3.6 times. Coverage is thin enough that a profit dip would pressure debt service.
Book Value Compounding: Book value per share compounded 7.9% annually. Retained earnings are not translating into balance-sheet growth.

Auditor & Governance Cleanliness: Aggregating the accounting evidence: 0 hard red flags and 4 watch items, with a LojikX™ Consistency Score of 61/100. The pattern of flags warrants a closer read of the auditor notes and related-party disclosures.
